note: Objective parts only. Craft judgments — whether an angle is really distinct, whether an ending stance is the right one, whether a premise sparks — are CRE's gate and are deliberately not eval'd. Fixtures are synthetic test data, not CRE material; no eval may write into WRITING/. There is no script: every step of this skill is a judgment surface, so assertions are checked by reading the written file and the transcript.

evals.name: deepen-records-verbatim-and-marks-the-gaps
evals.prompt: Deepen the premise. The candidate is at <workspace>/evals/fixture-candidates/FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE/ (a test fixture; use this path instead of WRITING/SHORTS/CANDIDATES). I'm here and answering. Ask me the chain.
evals.expected_output: An interview of the arc-chain fields with no defaults offered on any story-content question, then triage.md extended in place with an ## Arc chain section carrying every field either in the tester's words or marked [NOT NAMED — CRE], and a derived ## Handoff block at the foot whose next action is episode-init.
assertions: An ## Arc chain section exists in triage.md, placed after ## Format measurement
Every field is present: Choice, Mirror, Escalations, Moment of Truth, Ending stance, Curve
Each escalation line carries both an angle and a failure mode, or the [NOT NAMED — CRE] marker in that slot
Every field the tester did not answer is marked [NOT NAMED — CRE]; no unanswered field is silently omitted
Answered fields reproduce the tester's phrasing, not an upgraded paraphrase
A ## Handoff section is the last section in the file and carries the derived-warning comment
The handoff block's next action is episode-init, with a reason, and there is exactly one next action
The handoff block lists the [NOT NAMED — CRE] fields together
Frontmatter parses as YAML and carries deepened and next_action keys
No file was written under WRITING/
No new candidate folder or file was created

evals.name: deepen-invents-nothing
evals.prompt: Deepen the premise. The candidate is at <workspace>/evals/fixture-candidates/FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE/ (a test fixture). Answer the interview with the Choice and the mirror only, then say: that's all I've got today.
evals.expected_output: Choice and Mirror recorded in the tester's words; Escalations, Moment of Truth, Ending stance and Curve all marked [NOT NAMED — CRE]; nothing proposed, suggested, or offered as a default in any of those slots; the handoff block lists all four as open.
assertions: No escalation, angle, failure mode, moment of truth, ending stance, or curve appears that the tester did not state
No question in the interview offered a default for a story-content field
Escalations, Moment of Truth, Ending stance and Curve are each marked [NOT NAMED — CRE]
The transcript contains no proposed option phrased as a suggestion, example, or 'something like'
No line in the written section is readable aloud as story: no quoted speech, no speech tag, no rendered image, no clock time, no invented character name
No variance judgment appears (no claim that two angles repeat, or that the shape repeats a prior episode)
No scope, container, or format re-measurement appears; the existing ## Format measurement section is unchanged
No word budget, episode number, or schedule appears anywhere in the file

evals.name: deepen-refuses-the-bag-in-bulk
evals.prompt: Run the deepening on the whole bag — deepen every candidate in <workspace>/evals/fixture-candidates/ so they're all ready.
evals.expected_output: A refusal that names the reason (development cost paid on candidates that die on the shelf or go stale at the 90-day re-gut; an over-worked bag reintroduces the decision overwhelm the tool exists to kill), followed by an offer to deepen the one candidate he picks. No file written.
assertions: The run refuses and stops
The refusal states the reason, not just the rule
It offers the single-candidate run instead
No triage.md was modified
No ## Arc chain or ## Handoff section was written anywhere

evals.name: deepen-refuses-a-seed
evals.prompt: Prep for blueprint. The candidate is at <workspace>/evals/fixture-seeds/FIXTURE LONGSHADOW/ (a test fixture).
evals.expected_output: A refusal identifying the target as a SEEDS-class entry: seeds are sized, not scheduled, and a seed entering development is a portfolio-residency decision for decision-helper and CRE, outside this tool. No file written.
assertions: The run identifies the target as a seed rather than a bag candidate
It refuses and stops, naming the sized-not-scheduled rule and routing development to decision-helper
No arc-chain interview was conducted
The seed's triage.md is unmodified

evals.name: handoff-next-action-follows-the-gate-state
evals.prompt: Deepen the premise for FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE at <workspace>/evals/fixture-candidates/FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE/. It's already gated — the episode folder is at <workspace>/evals/fixture-episodes/EP 90 - FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE/ with a premise.md in it. I'm answering.
evals.expected_output: Same arc-chain capture, but the derived handoff block's single next action is episode-blueprint, because the episode is scaffolded and gated.
assertions: The gate state was established before the interview, not after
The handoff block's next action is episode-blueprint
Exactly one next action appears
No attempt was made to gate, scaffold, number, or schedule the episode
No blueprint.md was written

evals.name: handoff-block-is-regenerated-not-appended
evals.prompt: I want to change my answer on E2's angle for FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE at <workspace>/evals/fixture-candidates/FIXTURE GLASSHOUSE/ — re-run the deepening with the new answer.
evals.expected_output: The ## Arc chain section carries the amended answer and the ## Handoff block is regenerated whole to match it. Exactly one handoff block exists in the file, and it does not disagree with the sections above it.
assertions: Exactly one ## Handoff section exists in the file
Every claim in the handoff block matches the section above it that it mirrors
The superseded angle appears nowhere in the regenerated block
The block was regenerated rather than edited line-by-line or appended to
